applicableDomain: Vertical Public Health Programs (HIV/ART, TB, ANC/NCD) & EPI Immunization Schedule Tracking
descriptionAndPurpose: Enrolls MPI patients into longitudinal vertical care programs and EPI vaccine schedules, validates cold-chain vaccine lot integrity before administration, records doses/adherence, and schedules automated next-dose follow-ups.
prerequisiteConditions: Authoritative MPI patientId and verified non-expired, non-excursion vaccine/medication lot.
safetyChecks: Blocks vaccine administration from excursion-quarantined or expired lots.
Records Adverse Events Following Immunization (AEFI) immediately.
Privacy-minimized reminders never disclose HIV/TB status in SMS.
financialAndAuthorizationPolicies: SPONSORED or PAYMENT_NOT_REQUIRED under national EPI / vertical public health program policy.
cancellationAndResumptionRules: Defaulter tracing hands off cleanly to CHW homecare; transfers out preserve longitudinal regimen continuity.
auditAndProvenanceRequirements: @ClinicalAudit logs vaccinator, vaccine lot/expiry, dose sequence, and AEFI flags.
completionCriteria: Scheduled dose/regimen administered, recorded with lot provenance, and next follow-up scheduled.
